◆ WHAT THIS DASHBOARD SHOWS

Before deploying in the field, ISTARI was prototyped and validated on a synthetic dataset -- a simulated SDOF concrete column model with known healthy and damaged states. The pipeline correctly classifies a healthy column (fn=21.1 Hz, health=85.2) and a damaged column (fn=17.4 Hz, 18% stiffness reduction, health=31.8 CRITICAL). This confirms that the scoring logic, frequency extraction, and health thresholds work as designed. The real field dashboard shows what we measured in the field, and how the results compare.
